title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ow6z: Fragment::from_bytes API change broke integration tests
description:
Commit 344c8fa1 simplified `Fragment::from_bytes` to take a single `&[u8]` argument (removing the `&mut [u8]` tile buffer parameter as the payload is now a borrowed slice). The fuzz target at `rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs` was updated, but the integration tests still use the old two-argument signature with `&mut tile`:

- `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs`: lines 214, 241, 379 — all call `Fragment::from_bytes(&wire, &mut tile)`
- `rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs`: lines 123, 125, 236 — all call `Fragment::from_bytes(..., &mut tile)`

`cargo test --no-run` fails with compilation errors on these call sites. The `cargo build` (lib-only) accidentally passed because integration tests are separate targets.

Fix: remove the `&mut tile` argument from all six call sites, and remove the unused `let mut tile = [0u8; TILE_SIZE];` declarations in both test files.
